key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 53-68% at $40-$100/bbl (competitive terms designed to attract IOCs post-Baleine discovery)
80% cost oil cap (maximum 80% of annual gross production for cost recovery)
35% (Impot sur les benefices industriels et commerciaux - IBIC; government pays contractor CIT in some contracts)
50-70% government profit oil (R-factor: IOC 50% at R below 1; declining to 30% at R above 2)
Petroci 10% carried interest (free through exploration; contributing from production; some blocks 15%)
